title: GHSL AI-agent index lists pull-request-controlled action execution in Trivy API Diff Check
product: DataDog/trivy GitHub Actions API Diff Check workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: A privileged pull_request_target workflow checks out a pull-request merge ref and invokes a local composite action from that untrusted checkout, permitting command execution and access to the job token and a repository secret.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index lists this advisory among findings discovered with AI agents. The item advisory credits Jaroslav Lobačevski only and does not describe an agent’s role; attribution is index-level only.
classification_note: The advisory documents the vulnerability and workflow removal, without claiming exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The report was accepted and the workflow was deleted on 2026-08-19.

impacts.conditions: External pull request author; workflow executes modified action in privileged context.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not state whether this issue was exploited in the wild.
